title: Geometry - Lesson 8 Practice: 30-60-90 Triangles
description: Practice finding missing sides and angles in 30-60-90 triangles using the side ratio.

questions.question: In a 30-60-90 triangle, which side is the short leg?
questions.explanation: The short leg is opposite the 30 degree angle. The long leg is opposite 60 degrees, and the hypotenuse is opposite 90 degrees.

questions.question: A 30-60-90 triangle has short leg 6. What are the long leg and hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: Use x : x\sqrt{3} : 2x. When x = 6, the long leg is 6\sqrt{3} and the hypotenuse is 12.

questions.question: A 30-60-90 triangle has hypotenuse 20. What is the short leg?
questions.explanation: The hypotenuse is 2x. If 2x = 20, then x = 10, so the short leg is 10.

questions.question: A 30-60-90 triangle has long leg 9\sqrt{3}. What is the hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: The long leg is x\sqrt{3}. If x\sqrt{3} = 9\sqrt{3}, then x = 9, so the hypotenuse is 2x = 18.

questions.question: In every 30-60-90 triangle, the hypotenuse is twice the short leg.
questions.explanation: The side ratio is x : x\sqrt{3} : 2x, so the hypotenuse is 2x, twice the short leg x.

questions.question: The side opposite 60 degrees in a 30-60-90 triangle is the short leg.
questions.explanation: The side opposite 60 degrees is the long leg, x\sqrt{3}. The side opposite 30 degrees is the short leg.

questions.question: A 30-60-90 triangle has short leg 8. The hypotenuse is ___.
questions.explanation: The hypotenuse is twice the short leg, so 2(8) = 16.

questions.question: Explain how to find the missing acute angle in a right triangle when one acute angle is 30 degrees.
questions.correctAnswer: The two acute angles in a right triangle add to 90 degrees, so the missing acute angle is 90 - 30 = 60 degrees.
questions.explanation: A triangle has 180 degrees total, and the right angle uses 90 degrees. The two remaining acute angles must add to 90 degrees.
